## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - CMEs (Mars, OSIRIS-APEX)
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-06-19T21:37:57Z
## Message ID: 20240619-AL-002
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Multiple CMEs have been detected as follows:
1: O-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-19T06:48Z.

Estimated speed: ~1111 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 20 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 75/-5 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-19T06:48:00-CME-001

2: C-type CME detected by STEREO A / SOHO. 

Start time of the event: 2024-06-19T07:00Z.

Estimated speed: ~606 km/s.

Estimated opening half-angle: 27 deg.

Direction (lon./lat.): 69/-20 in Heliocentric Earth Equatorial coordinates.

Activity ID: 2024-06-19T07:00:00-CME-001

Based on preliminary analysis by the Moon to Mars Space Weather Analysis Office and heliospheric modeling carried out at NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center, it is estimated that the CMEs may impact Mars (glancing blow) and OSIRIS-APEX (glancing blow).  The flank of the CMEs will reach Mars at 2024-06-23T00:00Z and OSIRIS-APEX at 2024-06-21T20:00Z (plus minus 7 hours). 


Links to the movies of the modeled event (includes CMEs: 2024-06-19T06:48:00-CME-001, 2024-06-19T07:00:00-CME-001):

http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240619_100500_2.0_anim.tim-vel.gif
http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240619_100500_2.0_ENLIL_CONE_timeline.gif
http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240619_100500_2.0_ENLIL_CONE_Mars_timeline.gif
http://iswa.gsfc.nasa.gov/downloads/20240619_100500_2.0_ENLIL_CONE_Osiris_timeline.gif


## Notes: 

These CME events (2024-06-19T06:48:00-CME-001 and 2024-06-19T07:00:00-CME-001) are associated with M1.1 flare from AR 3711 (S12W76) with ID 2024-06-19T06:15:00-FLR-001 which peaked at 2024-06-19T06:38Z. These are two fronts analyzed to originate from this singular eruption from AR 3711, in close enough range to be simulated together but far enough apart to be analyzed separately.


SCORE CME typification system:
S-type: CMEs with speeds less than 500 km/s
C-type: Common 500-999 km/s
O-type: Occasional 1000-1999 km/s
R-type: Rare 2000-2999 km/s
ER-type: Extremely Rare >3000 km/s
